Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, high-resolution, dramatic movie-poster composition with a thin antique gold rectangular border and worn parchment-metal texture around the edges.

Main subject: One imposing warrior-monk stands full body in the center, wading through a shallow stormy river. He is tall, broad, rugged, and dressed in layered tattered dark green and gray monk robes, wrapped belts, hanging pouches, rope ties, weathered boots, and a huge strand of black prayer beads around his neck. The blade is ornate bronze-gold with engraved patterns and sharp curved hooks. In his other hand he carries one small dark wooden traveling chest. Add exactly 5 narrative vignette scenes embedded in swirling circular mist portals around the character: 1 upper-left river struggle scene with a monk-like figure in turbulent water, 1 upper-right escort scene with a master riding a white horse and attendants, 1 mid-right pilgrimage scene with two travelers walking across a barren riverbank, 1 lower-left demon-slaying battle scene in rocks and waves, and 1 far-right distant mountain-road scene suggesting the westward journey. categories: 游戏素材,海报 / 传单,插画,摄影,角色,文字 / 排版,风景 / 自然
prompt_en:
Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic fantasy character-design poster for a guardian spirit called a Stand, blending ethereal Chinese typography with soft fashion photography and mythic creature design. The main subject is Higanbana · Wu, a young woman seated on a rough stone ledge beside a misty pond or stream, wearing a white ruched floral mini dress with thin straps and an oversized off-white knit cardigan slipping from one shoulder. Her hair is medium brown, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands around the face; pose is elegant, quiet, slightly melancholic, hands resting on the ledge, legs angled forward. Hide or softly blur the face if needed, keeping the mood anonymous and poetic.

Behind and above her right shoulder, create the Stand: a large translucent white dragon-deer / fox-dragon guardian spirit with an elongated delicate snout, flowing feather-like mane, branching antler or horn shapes, veil-like fins, silk ribbons, dangling gold chains and tassels, and many small white flowers blooming along its head and body. It should feel like fog, petals, and moonlight given animal form: beautiful, fragile, protective, slightly uncanny, not cartoonish. The spirit curves around the woman as if guarding her, occupying the upper-right half of the poster.

Environment and lighting: a shaded waterside garden with drooping willow branches, dark green foliage, reflective water, floating mist, translucent gauze ribbons, tiny glowing petals or fireflies, and warm morning backlight filtering through haze. Use a palette of ivory, pearl white, champagne beige, pale blush, muted moss green, smoky gray, and soft gold. Overall atmosphere: serene, romantic, spectral, elegant, dreamlike, with a faint sense of grief and distance.

Design the poster as an information-rich Stand profile sheet with refined white serif typography and thin decorative rules. Include exactly 6 text blocks: 1) upper-left small label in Chinese and English, “替身設定 / STAND NAME”; 2) large title “彼岸花・霧” with smaller romanization “Higanbana · Wu”; 3) a short poetic Chinese paragraph beneath the title; 4) mid-left section titled “特殊能力” with ability name “花影迷離” and romanization “Hua Ying Mi Li,” followed by a concise ability description; 5) bottom-left section titled “設計關聯” with several short bullet-like Chinese lines and exactly 7 circular color swatches in ivory, cream, warm beige, dusty pink, gray-green, deep moss, and taupe; 6) bottom-right quote box containing “「你看到的美好，也許只是我編織的夢。」” plus a smaller boxed profile headed “少女檔案” with brief attributes such as personality, image, aura, and preferences. Add one narrow vertical Chinese text panel on the right side over the spirit, framed by thin lines. Text should be decorative and readable enough to evoke a luxury editorial character sheet, without overwhelming the image.

Visual style: high-end fantasy editorial poster, ultra-detailed, soft-focus photorealism mixed with delicate illustration, translucent layers, bokeh, shallow depth of field, fine ornamental linework, elegant Chinese book-design aesthetics, no harsh neon colors, no modern UI, no watermark. Use 彼岸花・霧 as the largest title, 花影迷離 as the ability heading, and make the Stand feel like a white mist dragon-deer covered in flowers.\

prompt_en: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a III viaje fotográfico titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.\
